pictures.subject: Wasserkreislauf
pictures.prompt: Coloring-book page, pure white background, only solid black pen strokes, no fill, no gray, no blue, no color, no shading, no letters, no words, no numbers, no captions, no arrows with text. A primary-school water cycle: sea at the lower left, mountain in the centre, river running down the right into the sea, sun at the upper left drawn as a circle with straight rays, two outlined clouds, rain as short vertical dashes under one cloud, vapour as three empty curved arrows rising from the sea, rain falling on the mountain slope, water seeping down through dotted soil into a thin dotted groundwater band, and the river returning to the sea. No faces.
reported: An image reader reported words on this file. No OCR was available, so the words are not proven. The same reader invented blue and green on files whose channels differ by at most 5.
The reader reported groundwater as an underground lake. Groundwater fills gaps in the soil and the rock. That reading was not checked by OCR.

pictures.cost: nothing charged to a Blattomat account; the tool publishes no price

terms.model: the generator of these twelve JPEGs
terms.read: No terms and no model name are in the JPEG metadata, and the tool published none. These files are the experiment record, not pictures the app ships.

As between the user and OpenAI, the user owns the output, and OpenAI assigns any interest it has. Output may not be unique. It must not be presented as human-made. OpenAI may use content to train unless the user opts out. Accuracy is not guaranteed. Read on 2026-10-22. These are the consumer terms, not an API data-processing agreement, and not ChatGPT for Teachers.

Education-only use in the teacher's role. Not for personal or commercial projects unrelated to that work. The help page says it is free through June 2028 for verified U.S. K-12 educators, and that it includes image generation. A German Grundschule teacher is outside that offer. Read on 2026-10-22.

Additional terms effective 2026-03-23: Google does not claim ownership of generated content, and may generate the same content for others. On unpaid services, Google uses prompts and outputs to improve its products, and human reviewers may read them. The API must not be used in a client directed at, or likely to be accessed by, people under 18. Image docs say generated images include a SynthID watermark. Not called.

EU developer terms, read 2026-10-22: as between the parties, the customer owns the output and may use it personally or commercially. Output may not be unique, may be wrong, and must not be presented as human-made. Content credentials must not be stripped. The EU API terms, last revised 2026-08-26, also give Black Forest Labs a perpetual licence to use input and output to improve its models, including training. Not called. The EU pricing page did not yield numbers in the fetch, so no FLUX price is recorded.

costGuess.assumption: 200 pictures a year, one try each, at a published price for a 1024 square. The 200 is a guess, not a count of what a teacher does.
